title: JIT channel invoices are created with no limit on the opening fee the LSP deducts from the incoming payment

bugs.note: The last argument of ReceiveViaJitChannel is the maximum total LSP fee; nil means no limit. The LSP opens the channel and takes its opening fee out of the payment it forwards, so whatever fee it quotes at that moment is accepted: a 10,000 sat receive can arrive as a few sats, and the user is never asked.
